position_overview: Looking for Filipino (Philippines-based) candidates Job Role: VA Ops, Ecomm, Market Coordinator Compensation range: $2000 AUD / Monthly Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you'll have flexibility in how you manage your time. Who We Are: At Hunt St , we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home. Who The Client Is: A growing Australian business specialising in branded apparel, workwear, and promotional products, supported by ecommerce and digital platforms. They serve a wide range of clients with customised solutions and operate in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment with strong opportunities for long-term development. Role Overview: This is a hybrid, multi-functional support role working closely with management to drive day-to-day operations and business efficiency. You'll be a key contributor across ecommerce, marketing, administration, systems coordination, and customer support, helping keep everything organised, on track, and running smoothly. The right person is highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple areas of the business. You take ownership of your work, support workflow efficiency, and contribute to improving systems, online presence, and overall customer experience across a growing operation.
